title: Web UI response edit key was 'msg' not 'reason' (setattr silently no-ops)
answers: Why is edited reason phrase not sent in web UI?
Which keys does the web flow update handler accept for response?
body:
Original bug: HttpMessages.tsx sent `response: { msg }` and app.py flow update handler did `setattr(response, k, str(v))` for k in ["msg","http_version"]. `Response` has only a `reason` property (mitmproxy/http.py:Response.reason), so `msg` set a stray attribute and never changed the wire reason.
Fix: app.py branch now `["reason","http_version"]` (msg removed -> 400 Unknown update); HttpMessages.tsx sends `{ reason }`; test_app.py update test sends/asserts `reason` (it previously asserted `f.response.msg`, masking the bug).
Update keys are written by setattr, so a wrong key name fails silently; check that the key is a real attribute.
applies: Response updates via PUT /flows/<id>; request path uses separate explicit branches.
